sentences.text: 2 09-07-2025 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Rampur Chauram P.S. Case No. 66 of 2024 registered for the offence under Sections 366 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the allegation against the petitioner is that he kidnapped the victim girl.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has not committed any offence.
The petitioner is in custody since 03.12.2024.
5. Learned A.P.P. appearing for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
From the statement of the victim girl, it appears that she got married with the petitioner.
